name: bell
description: Represents a notification or alert action. On hover or trigger, the bell body swings with a natural decaying oscillation (±8° to 0°, hinged at top ring 12px 4px) while the clapper counter-swings in sync (±14° to 0°, hinged at attachment point 12px 21px).

animation.description: The bell body and clapper oscillate in opposite directions with decaying keyframe arrays (0.7s duration, easeInOut). Bell body is hinged at (12px, 4px) and clapper at (12px, 21px). Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Ensure screen readers announce notification state changes when paired with a badge or status text.
